find-filtered.sql: SELECT "account"."id", "account"."name", "account"."display_name" FROM "app"."account" WHERE "account"."id" >= $1 ORDER BY "account"."name" DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

find-joined.sql: SELECT "post"."id", "post"."author_id", "post"."title" FROM "app"."post" INNER JOIN "app"."account" ON "post"."author_id" = "account"."id" WHERE "account"."name" = $1

enum-comparison.sql: SELECT "moody"."id", "moody"."mood" FROM "app"."moody" WHERE "moody"."mood" = CAST($1::text AS app.mood)

update-changes.sql: UPDATE "app"."account" SET "name" = $1 WHERE "account"."id" >= $2 RETURNING WITH (OLD AS "pgorm_old", NEW AS "pgorm_new") "pgorm_old"."id" AS "o_id", "pgorm_old"."name" AS "o_name", "pgorm_old"."display_name" AS "o_display_name", "pgorm_new"."id" AS "n_id", "pgorm_new"."name" AS "n_name", "pgorm_new"."display_name" AS "n_display_name"

insert-upserts.sql: INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("id", "name") VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET "name" = "excluded"."name" RETURNING WITH (OLD AS "pgorm_old", NEW AS "pgorm_new") "pgorm_old"."id" AS "o_id", "pgorm_old"."name" AS "o_name", "pgorm_old"."display_name" AS "o_display_name", "pgorm_new"."id" AS "n_id", "pgorm_new"."name" AS "n_name", "pgorm_new"."display_name" AS "n_display_name"

graph.sql: SELECT "post"."id" AS "s0_id", "post"."author_id" AS "s0_author_id", "post"."title" AS "s0_title", "account"."id" AS "s1_id", "account"."name" AS "s1_name", "account"."display_name" AS "s1_display_name" FROM "app"."post" INNER JOIN "app"."account" ON "post"."author_id" = "account"."id"

graph-maybe-alias.sql: SELECT "account"."id" AS "s0_id", "account"."name" AS "s0_name", "account"."display_name" AS "s0_display_name", "p"."id" AS "s1_id", "p"."author_id" AS "s1_author_id", "p"."title" AS "s1_title" FROM "app"."account" LEFT JOIN "app"."post" AS "p" ON "account"."id" = "p"."author_id"

graph-via.sql: SELECT "post"."id" AS "s0_id", "post"."author_id" AS "s0_author_id", "post"."title" AS "s0_title", "tag"."id" AS "s1_id", "tag"."label" AS "s1_label" FROM "app"."post" LEFT JOIN "app"."post_tag" ON "post"."id" = "post_tag"."post_id" LEFT JOIN "app"."tag" ON "post_tag"."tag_id" = "tag"."id"

graph-filtered.sql: SELECT "post"."id" AS "s0_id", "post"."author_id" AS "s0_author_id", "post"."title" AS "s0_title", "account"."id" AS "s1_id", "account"."name" AS "s1_name", "account"."display_name" AS "s1_display_name" FROM "app"."post" INNER JOIN "app"."account" ON "post"."author_id" = "account"."id" WHERE "post"."title" = $1 ORDER BY "post"."id" ASC

graph-grouped.sql: SELECT "account"."id" AS "s0_id", "account"."name" AS "s0_name", "account"."display_name" AS "s0_display_name", "post"."id" AS "s1_id", "post"."author_id" AS "s1_author_id", "post"."title" AS "s1_title" FROM "app"."account" LEFT JOIN "app"."post" ON "account"."id" = "post"."author_id" ORDER BY "account"."name" DESC, "account"."id" ASC

cursor-after-first.sql: SELECT "account"."id", "account"."name", "account"."display_name" FROM "app"."account" WHERE "account"."id" > $1 ORDER BY "account"."id" ASC LIMIT $2

cursor-composite-last-desc.sql: SELECT "account"."id", "account"."name", "account"."display_name" FROM "app"."account" WHERE ("account"."name" = $1 AND "account"."id" > $2) OR "account"."name" > $3 ORDER BY "account"."name" ASC, "account"."id" ASC LIMIT $4

graph-cursor-with.sql: SELECT "post"."id" AS "s0_id", "post"."author_id" AS "s0_author_id", "post"."title" AS "s0_title", "account"."id" AS "s1_id", "account"."name" AS "s1_name", "account"."display_name" AS "s1_display_name" FROM "app"."post" LEFT JOIN "app"."account" ON "post"."author_id" = "account"."id" WHERE ("post"."title" = $1 AND "post"."id" = $2 AND "account"."id" > $3) OR ("post"."title" = $4 AND "post"."id" > $5) OR "post"."title" > $6 ORDER BY "post"."title" ASC, "post"."id" ASC, "account"."id" ASC LIMIT $7

page.sql: SELECT "account"."id", "account"."name", "account"."display_name" FROM "app"."account" ORDER BY "account"."id" ASC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "num_items" FROM (SELECT "account"."id", "account"."name", "account"."display_name" FROM "app"."account" WHERE "account"."name" <> $1) AS "sub_query"
